_README.what: A COPY of waiver template 2 exported from another environment by dev/template_export.php. Consumed by dev/predeploy.php when SEED_WAIVER_TEMPLATE_FILE points at it.
_README.not: NOT the source of truth. The legally-operative document is the one the operator edits by hand in the PRODUCTION admin UI. This copy goes stale the moment that one is edited; re-run the export to refresh it. Nothing reads this file on production, and the seed cannot overwrite an existing template id even if it did (src/TemplateSeed.php, Lock 2).
_README.pii: PII-free by construction: only waiver_templates + waiver_template_versions are exported. Signer data lives in waiver_instances / waiver_responses and is never read.

versions.content_html:
Terms and Conditions – Personal Data Protection for Participation in GATEWAY VR STUDIO Activities

GDPR:

I hereby expressly agree that GATEWAY VR STUDIO SRL, located in Bucharest, Sector 5, Str. Sg. Maj. Vasile Topliceanu, no. 8, room 3, Bloc P37, staircase 2, apartment 44, registered with the Trade Register under no. J40/21127/2023, having tax ID 51103868, hereinafter referred to as the "Operator", may use and process my personal data provided as a client of GATEWAY VR STUDIO.

The data processing is carried out in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), exclusively for the purposes mentioned below.

Please note that the studio premises are under video surveillance throughout the entire experience.

Consent regarding the processing of personal data, as well as the provision of the data mentioned below, is voluntary. This consent may be revoked at any time, with future effect, by written notice sent to the email address play@vrstudio.ro or delivered to the registered office of Gateway VR Studio, Sector 5, Str. Sg. Maj. Vasile Topliceanu, no. 8, Bl P37, Staircase 2, Ap. 44, Bucharest. Please note that withdrawal of consent does not affect the legality of data usage prior to its withdrawal (the notice has no retroactive effect). If consent is not granted or has been revoked, the personal data will not be used for the purposes mentioned above. If you have any questions regarding this consent statement or data protection by SC Gateway Entertainment SRL in general, please do not hesitate to contact our Data Protection Officer at play@vrstudio.ro.

1. GENERAL RULES OF CONDUCT

1.1. Participants must follow all instructions provided by Gateway VR Studio staff.
1.2. It is strictly forbidden to use force on the equipment: pulling cables, damaging VR devices, consoles, simulator seats, PCs, or any other item on the premises.
1.3. Any violent, destructive, hostile, or dangerous behavior toward oneself or others will result in immediate termination of the activity without refund and may lead to legal action.

1.4. During VR activities, the following is strictly prohibited:

Running or moving quickly and uncontrollably in the play area;

Jumping, diving, climbing, sudden spinning, or any other dangerous movements that may lead to injuries;

Intentional or unintentional physical contact with other participants;

Aggressive or wide hand movements that may strike others or damage equipment;

Forcefully removing or tampering with VR headsets, controllers, cables, or other components;

Ignoring warning signals provided by staff or devices.

2. USE OF VR EQUIPMENT, CONSOLES, RACING SIMULATORS, PC GAMING

2.1. All equipment is intended for recreational use in a safe manner. Participants take full responsibility for improper use.
2.2. Participants confirm that they do not suffer from conditions incompatible with the use of the equipment (e.g., epilepsy, heart conditions, severe vertigo, extreme sensitivity to flashing lights, etc.).
2.3. Children under the age of 14 may participate only under adult supervision. For certain equipment, the minimum age may be higher, depending on the manufacturer’s specifications.
2.4. Modifying device settings without staff approval is not allowed.

3. SAFETY AND SUPERVISION

3.1. Strict safety measures apply on our premises. Game areas are monitored via video for safety and activity management purposes.
3.2. Participants are informed about the existence of panic buttons or emergency stop mechanisms available on certain equipment.
3.3. Any accident or health issue must be immediately reported to staff.

4. CONDUCT AND PROHIBITIONS

4.1. Participation under the influence of alcohol or psychoactive substances is prohibited. Individuals in such a state will be denied access without refund.
4.2. Smoking is prohibited indoors. Access with weapons, blunt objects, or sharp items is also forbidden.
4.3. Bullying of any kind (verbal, physical, or psychological) is strictly prohibited.
4.4. Recording video, taking photos, or copying digital content displayed on screens without written consent from Gateway VR Studio is not allowed.

5. DAMAGES AND LIABILITY

5.1. Participants will be held responsible for any material damage caused to the equipment or the location.
5.2. Damages will be assessed by our staff, and the associated costs will be borne by the responsible individual.
5.3. Severe damages may lead to the cancellation of bookings for other clients. In such cases, the responsible participant will be required to pay for the canceled games.
